Elegant restaurant, very good meal
Feb 2020 • Couples
This restaurant has very nice, upscale decor, so you are dining upstairs in very pleasant surroundings. The tables are nicely separated and the atmosphere is quiet and subdued. Fortunately the food is a match for the nice surroundings. We had fresh spring rolls, grilled catfish Hanoi style and lemongrass chicken, and tasty and very well prepared and presented. They also have a few good wines, including by the glass. Service was very efficient and quick. This was a very nice dinner!

good food negated by thieving waitress
Nov 2019
The restaurant is very attractively decorated.

The food was tasty at a little above mid-range prices, with a service charge added .
we had mango and prawn salad, beef in betel leaves and chicken in northern spices, 2 beers and 2 steamed rice and enjoyed all of the dishes.

The bill with service charge was 607 so I left a 500, a 100 and a 10 in the folder.
The waitress took this away for a while and when I was leaving the upstairs room approached me and showed me the folder which now contained a 500 and 2 10s.

I have been in Vietnam for 3 weeks and can distinguish a 100 from a 10 just on size, but in this instance had counted the zeros also.

This was on 16th November at about 18:30.
